items.text: Many young Brits are buying binoculars in hopes of encountering one of nature's most physically and audibly beautiful creatures - birds.

You might think of birdwatching as an old-fashioned pastime most often enjoyed by the generations before you, but surveys conducted by the RSPB show a 47% increase in participation overall, with an even higher 1,088% surge by Gen Zers.
So, why do so many young people want to flock to the park to watch birds?

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: to flock to the park to watch birds

items.text: A group leader at RSPB Bristol highlighted how many students have joined his outings.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: A group leader at RSPB Bristol

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: how many students have joined his outings

items.text: He mentioned that some who join have 'never been out in their local nature spaces' and 'want to explore'.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that some who join have 'never been out in their local nature spaces' and 'want to explore'

items.text: He added that the diversity of species you can find is impressive 'considering it's so urban' around the city.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that the diversity of species you can find is impressive 'considering it's so urban' around the city

items.text: There is also the rise of a desire to disconnect from technology and go outside, or as Gen Z would call it touch grass, to help with mental health.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: the rise of a desire to disconnect from technology and go outside, or as Gen Z would call it touch grass, to help with mental health

level2.label: 后置定语
level2.text: to disconnect from technology and go outside

level2.label: 插入语
level2.text: as Gen Z would call it touch grass

items.text: Research from the University of Surrey has looked at how bird sounds restore attention and even alleviate stress.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: Research from the University of Surrey

items.text: Ironically, when interviewed by BBC Bristol, individuals mentioned how phones and social media have actually helped encourage the hype of this hobby.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: how phones and social media have actually helped encourage the hype of this hobby

items.text: There are now a variety of apps in which you can record a birdsong and have it instantly identified.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: a variety of apps in which you can record a birdsong and have it instantly identified

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: in which you can record a birdsong and have it instantly identified

items.text: People also use social media to share knowledge and location for birds.

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: to share knowledge and location for birds

items.text: A phenomenon known as 'bioblitzing', a combination of bio and blitzing, has emerged.

level1.label: 同位语
level1.text: a combination of bio and blitzing

items.text: This is when a walker documents as many birds and other species of animals as they can within a limited amount of time.

level1.label: 表语从句
level1.text: when a walker documents as many birds and other species of animals as they can within a limited amount of time

level2.label: 时间状语
level2.text: within a limited amount of time

items.text: It has been said to create a safe space in which birdwatchers can get into friendly competitions over who can spot the most!

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: a safe space in which birdwatchers can get into friendly competitions over who can spot the most

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: in which birdwatchers can get into friendly competitions over who can spot the most

items.text: Furthermore, a buzz around the birdwatching hashtag has cultivated humour around turning 30 and entering your 'birdwatching era'.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: a buzz around the birdwatching hashtag

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: humour around turning 30 and entering your 'birdwatching era'

items.text: Whether it's the chance to reconnect with nature, improve mental wellbeing, or join a growing online community, birdwatching is no longer seen as a hobby reserved for older generations.

level1.label: 让步状语从句
level1.text: Whether it's the chance to reconnect with nature, improve mental wellbeing, or join a growing online community

items.text: Young people are embracing it in record numbers, using both technology and the outdoors to discover the wildlife on their doorstep.

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: using both technology and the outdoors to discover the wildlife on their doorstep

items.text: From identifying birdsongs with apps to competing in bioblitzing challenges, a modern twist has transformed the pastime into something fresh and accessible.
It seems that for Gen Z and young millennials alike, birdwatching has become a hoot.

level1.label: 主语从句
level1.text: that for Gen Z and young millennials alike, birdwatching has become a hoot
